# WO-195: Build a route-scoped website refresh foundation
Status: delivered; owner review requested (issue #178)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Amara Okoye
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`

## Goal
Create a polished, reusable visual foundation for the public-site refresh without changing shared tokens or existing routes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Add the separate `site-refresh.css` stylesheet and plain Astro components; styles are namespaced below `.site-refresh` and use existing `var(--...)` tokens for every color.
- Do not hard-code colors. If a needed token is missing, list it in worktree `VENDOR_STATUS.md` as a CHANGE REQUEST and wait for owner direction.
- Support D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other text >=4.5:1) in both themes, visible focus, reduced motion, 320px minimum layout, body text >=20px, and tap targets >=44px.
- README documents component use and says this is a staging layer: after WO-204 passes, in-house folds retained parts into the main design system and removes the namespace. One design system remains long-term.
- Plain Astro and CSS only. No imports from `components/aceternity/` or `components/magicui/`, no `client:` directives, scripts, external requests, inline styles, or dependencies.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/styles/site-refresh.css` (new)
- `web/src/components/site-refresh/` (new files only)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No page edits, `web/src/styles/tokens.css`, `web/src/styles/global.css`, app-shared files, CSP/build config, package manifests, CI, or existing components.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`
- `ruff check tests/codex` is not applicable; record that this is a visual foundation and identify any manual checks performed.

## Check-in plan
Owner tooling prepares `.vendor-wt/wo-195`. WO-196 starts alongside this foundation. Page work depends on both WOs being reviewed and available on the owner's local main. Refreshed pages import `site-refresh.css` and wrap content in `.site-refresh`; header, footer, and base layout remain untouched.

## Notes and decisions
Keep global chrome and existing non-refresh routes visually unchanged. No broad redesign of shared app/site tokens.
